name: Vinetsʹ tvorinnya
source:
Eugene is a student at the academy, where he studies artificial intelligence systems. All his free time he communicates with neural networks instead of people. But he still doesn't know how the next chatbot will irreversibly change his life.

[Translated from [url=https://strayant-studio.itch.io/aegis]itch.io[/url]]
